contribution_boundary.allowed_claim: Hard Grounded Research contributes an HF-derived, script-reproducible benchmark suite for large-corpus research QA that combines multi-hop synthesis, stale/current conflicts, lifecycle changes, table-text reasoning, authority conflicts, insufficiency/abstention, citation-overreach, entity disambiguation, as-of-date temporal reasoning, and cross-document contradiction under common evidence contracts.
prohibited_claims: First evidence insufficiency or abstention benchmark.
Novelty for any single category independent of the unified hard-grounded research-QA suite.
required_manuscript_moves: Cite or contrast every high-overlap source in the final related-work section.
State that individual subproblems are crowded and the contribution is the combined HF-derived research-QA stress suite.
Keep human review framed as optional audit rather than primary data generation.
Keep final novelty and completion claims blocked until the final novelty audit incorporates this adjudication.

adjudication_rows.title: ConflictRAG: Detecting and Resolving Knowledge Conflicts in Retrieval Augmented Generation
adjudication_rows.claim_action: Do not claim novelty for conflict detection or conflict resolution; cite as adjacent contradiction/conflict RAG work.

adjudication_rows.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Conflicting Evidence
adjudication_rows.claim_action: Treat conflicting-evidence RAG as prior work and reserve novelty for explicit research-QA evidence contracts across multiple failure categories.

adjudication_rows.title: What Should I Cite? A RAG Benchmark for Academic Citation Prediction
overlap: citation supports fact but not conclusion
adjudication_rows.claim_action: Separate academic citation prediction from conclusion-support-overreach scoring; cite for citation-related overlap.

adjudication_rows.title: Sufficient Context: A New Lens on Retrieval Augmented Generation Systems
adjudication_rows.claim_action: Do not claim abstention or context sufficiency as novel; claim only the combined insufficiency/citation-overreach/research-QA packaging.

adjudication_rows.title: MuDABench: A Benchmark for Multi-Document Analytical QA
adjudication_rows.claim_action: Cite multi-document analytical QA as close prior work; narrow novelty to hard-grounded failure taxonomy and HF-derived provenance.

adjudication_rows.title: Towards Global Retrieval Augmented Generation: A Benchmark for Global QA
adjudication_rows.claim_action: Use as large-scale/global QA background and avoid broad large-corpus QA novelty claims.

adjudication_rows.title: RAGChecker: A Fine-grained Framework for Diagnosing Retrieval-Augmented Generation
adjudication_rows.claim_action: Cite diagnostic RAG evaluation; keep this benchmark claim focused on dataset/task construction rather than metric novelty.

adjudication_rows.title: RAGBench: Explainable Benchmark for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
adjudication_rows.claim_action: Cite explainable RAG benchmarking as background and avoid generic RAG benchmark novelty claims.

adjudication_rows.title: LIT-RAGBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Language Models as Integrated Tabular and Textual Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
adjudication_rows.claim_action: Do not claim table-text RAG or abstention benchmark novelty; position table-text as one category within the unified hard-grounded suite.

adjudication_rows.title: Is This Snippet Worth Citing? Towards Evidence Force in Cited-RAG
overlap: citation supports fact but not conclusion
adjudication_rows.claim_action: Do not claim evidence-force or citation-worthiness novelty; claim conclusion-support-overreach only as part of the cross-category research-QA benchmark.

adjudication_rows.title: T2-RAGBench: Benchmarking Retrieval-Augmented Generation over Text-and-Table Data
adjudication_rows.claim_action: Do not claim text-table RAG novelty; cite as direct table-text prior work and keep novelty at the combined suite level.

adjudication_rows.title: Faithfulness-QA: A Counterfactual Entity Substitution Dataset for Training Context-Faithful RAG Models
adjudication_rows.claim_action: Position counterfactual-context faithfulness as adjacent to entity/state confusion, while keeping hard-grounded novelty limited to multi-source research evidence and conclusion-support failures.

adjudication_rows.title: FaithEval: Can Your Language Model Stay Faithful to Context, Even If Context Is Noisy?
adjudication_rows.claim_action: Cite noisy-context faithfulness work and reserve novelty for the combined evidence sufficiency, source authority, and citation-overreach taxonomy.

adjudication_rows.title: Context-DPO: Aligning Language Models for Context-Faithfulness
adjudication_rows.claim_action: Cite context-faithfulness alignment work and avoid claiming novelty for generic hallucination control in QA.

adjudication_rows.title: LegalBench-RAG: A Benchmark for Retrieval-Augmented Generation in the Legal Domain
adjudication_rows.claim_action: Cite LegalBench-RAG as domain-specific legal RAG unless its source structure directly tests authority hierarchy or cross-document contradiction.

adjudication_rows.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation Evaluation in the Era of Large Language Models: A Comprehensive Survey
adjudication_rows.claim_action: Cite the RAG evaluation survey as broad evaluation/taxonomy prior work and keep novelty limited to hard-grounded research-QA failure categories and HF-derived item construction.

adjudication_rows.title: Benchmarking Fine-Grained RAG: Granular Assessment and Error Analysis in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
adjudication_rows.claim_action: Remove any generic fine-grained RAG benchmarking novelty claim; limit novelty to the hard-grounded research-QA construct and review/gold workflow.

adjudication_rows.title: GRACE: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Contextual Reasoning in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
adjudication_rows.claim_action: Compare GRACE against the multi-hop, contradiction, and temporal categories before claiming hard-grounded reasoning coverage.
